summary: Iter 122 NEO Chat orchestrator + 4 new NEO Report types + Secretaria ask_neo tool. All 17 backend tests PASSED (auth guards, 7 tools listing, 5 ask intents including freeform/phone/days mapping, history+sessions chronology, 4 new report types create+run with PDF > 1000 bytes, secretaria→neo end-to-end). LLM is non-deterministic so assertions accept any valid tool from the 7-tool catalog while still validating tool_data shape when the expected tool was chosen.

minor.issue: LLM call (gpt-4o-mini via emergentintegrations) occasionally exceeds 60s — added retry+90s timeout in tests; first run hit 502/timeout twice. Consider streaming or shorter system prompts.

critical_code_review_comments: neo_chat.py POST /ask makes 2 sequential LLM calls (route + summarize) — adds latency (~10-25s). Consider single-call function-calling format or caching when same question repeats in session.
_tool_alvaro_tickets calls db.list_collection_names() on every request just to check if 'alvaro_analyses' exists — costly; either always query (and catch) or cache the collection list.
TOOL_CATALOG_PROMPT is global — when adding new tools update prompt and TOOLS dict; consider deriving catalog from a single registry to avoid drift.
/api/neo-chat/ask body validation: pydantic AskIn allows empty session_id but no length cap on `question` — add max_length to prevent prompt-injection of huge payloads.
neo_reports POST /schedules requires `hour` field — confirmed needed but error message in 422 is fine; main agent should document required fields in API contract.
seed_data_creation: Created neo_chat_messages for session 'neo-test-iter122' (2+ msgs). Created 4 TEST_ schedules (isabella_kpis, alvaro_tickets, camila_billing, secretaria_intents) — all deleted at end of each test via DELETE /api/neo-reports/schedules/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite test_iter122_neo_chat_orchestrator.py covers all NEO endpoints + Secretaria ask_neo tool. LLM tests use 90s timeout + 1 retry due to occasional emergentintegrations slowness. Schedule POST requires `hour` field (int 0-23). All 4 new report types (isabella_kpis, alvaro_tickets, camila_billing, secretaria_intents) generate PDFs via reportlab > 1KB. Secretaria correctly invokes ask_neo tool internally (iterations >= 1 in response). Total runtime ~2m 35s.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found; all features working end-to-end.
